title: icb.yaml
description: Per-project settings for icb (interactivecodebase) analysis. Every field is optional.

lang.description: The project's language. Default: scala for a directory with a build.sbt and no go.mod, go otherwise.

scala.description: How icb analyzes an sbt project: sbt compiles it and reports each project's classpath, then the icb-scala extractor reads the TASTy of the project's own classes.

extractor.description: The icb-scala command (make scala-extractor writes extractors/scala/target/icb-scala). A relative path is relative to the project. Default: $ICB_SCALA, then icb-scala on PATH.

projects.description: The sbt projects to analyze. Default: every project the build aggregates.

packages.description: Package patterns to analyze, relative to the module root. Default: ./...

exclude.description: Package path prefixes left out as call targets (noise such as logging), on top of the defaults (fmt, strings, log, context, ...).

noDefaultExclude.description: Use only exclude, not the defaults.

sinks.description: Extra calls that leave the program, e.g. the module's own client for a third-party API. func may name a function, a method or an interface method.

func.description: go/ssa name of the function, e.g. (*example.com/app/stripe.Client).Charge or (example.com/app/service.Mailer).Send.

arg.description: Index of the argument naming what the sink touches (SQL text, URL, file name), counting after the receiver. Omit for none.

label.description: Name shown for the sink, e.g. Stripe API.

guards.description: Functions that check authentication, in addition to request-taking functions named *authenticat*. For Scala, the zio-http aspects or middleware that do.

func.description: go/ssa name, e.g. example.com/app/auth.RequireUser; for Scala the aspect's name, e.g. app.http.RouteSupport.staffOnly, or a suffix of it.

role.description: Access passing the guard grants. Default: authenticated.

roleFields.description: Regular expressions (Go syntax) matching the names of fields a guard branches on to require a role. Defaults: (?i)admin, (?i)guest.

migrations.description: Directories with SQL migrations, relative to the module root. Default: migrations, db/migrations, sql/schema and similar.

values.description: Possible values of things the analysis cannot resolve statically, keyed by the go/ssa name of a package variable, function or interface method (its result, or the elements of a returned slice), or env:NAME for os.Getenv("NAME"). Route prefixes and names from configuration are the typical use.
